expected_behavior: Ask through panels, never in prose. A panel is the host's question UI in one of four shapes: `single` (one of 2-5 options + free answer), `multi` (several + open form), `open` (free text only), `confirm` (yes/no).

Clarify scope (if incomplete) — Ask one panel at a time (`single`, `multi`, or `open`) covering: target audience, core entities, key use cases, auth model, pagination, rate limiting, versioning. Never ask in prose.
`save-design.mjs` only creates the file and prints its absolute path on stdout; the agent fills in the body afterwards.
Writes a new timestamped file every run — it never overwrites an existing draft, so re-running the same topic produces a second file.
Timestamps are always JS-generated; there is no `--date` flag. Use `--branch <name>` when git is unavailable (otherwise the branch is auto-detected via `git rev-parse`).
